WITH telescope_obs AS (
  SELECT 
    t.*,
    o.weathprofile
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1
),
weather_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    weathprofile,
    AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescope_obs
  GROUP BY weathprofile
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) AS mean_avg_bandwidth
  FROM weather_stats
  WHERE avg_bandwidth IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ws.weathprofile,
  ws.avg_bandwidth,
  ws.telescope_count,
  ws.avg_bandwidth - om.mean_avg_bandwidth AS diff_from_mean
FROM weather_stats ws
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE om.mean_avg_bandwidth IS NOT NULL
  AND ws.avg_bandwidth IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ws.weathprofile
